messages.subject: Re: sem function - unused argument (data = ...)
parts:
On 07/29/2015 12:09 AM, Mike wrote:
> But I get the error message;
> Error in sem(model, data = PoliticalDemocracy) :
> unused argument (data = PoliticalDemocracy)

Have you also installed the sem package? The 'sem()' function you are
using is not lavaan's sem() function. If more than one package defines a
sem() function, R will by default use the one from the package that was
loaded last.

To be sure you are calling lavaan's sem() function, try:

fit <- lavaan::sem(model, data=PoliticalDemocracy)

Yves.
